about: The test set (decided with the user on 2026-11-08): a third of each section of the user's seed questions, chosen at random with a fixed seed and taken out of seed_questions.md before any generation, so the generator never saw them. Each is asked as synthetic user 31 (never a training or validation user) on that user's today; 'seed' is the question as the user wrote it, 'question' as asked, with an item, shop or period the user 31 data lacks swapped for one it has. Answers are scored as in the pilot.
